2609.13582.title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
2609.13582.paper_summary: A clinical agent benchmark can report the same verdict on identical inputs while the agent files a materially different order on each run. Such agents order tests, request medications and place referrals, yet benchmarks typically score one run per task and rarely ask whether identical inputs produce identical actions; MedAgentBench, the benchmark we use, scores a single attempt and says so. To measure this gap we introduce "same-input rerun", which replays a task with every input held fixed and compares the orders rather than the score, with six reliability metrics, and apply it to 1000 MedAgentBench runs across 50 tasks from its five write-capable families, two open-weight models below ten billion parameters quantised to four bits, and two temperatures. The study establishes that action-level divergence exists and can pass unrecorded by the score, not that any rate generalises. Under the 8B model at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different set of orders across five identical runs, 26 emit the order on some runs and not others, and 28 record a different coded value, dose or analyte. In 22 of those 43 the benchmark reports the same failing verdict for materially different behaviour, as it does for all 10 divergent groups of the 4B model at 0.7. Orders also reach different endpoints across runs, one of which the record server rejects while the agent is told it succeeded. These findings motivate repeated-run evaluation, action-level stability reporting and execution-faithful environment feedback in clinical-agent benchmarks.
2609.13582.paper_summary_zh: 臨床代理基準可以在相同的輸入上報告相同的判決，而該代理在每次運行時卻提交了實質上不同的訂單。這些代理訂購測試、請求藥物和進行轉診，但基準通常每個任務只計分一次，並且很少詢問相同的輸入是否產生相同的行為；我們使用的基準 MedAgentBench 計分一次嘗試並明確指出。為了測量這個差距，我們引入了「相同輸入重跑」，這個方法在每個輸入固定的情況下重播任務，並比較訂單而不是分數，使用六個可靠性指標，並將其應用於 1000 次 MedAgentBench 運行，涵蓋其五個可寫入的家族中的 50 個任務，兩個低於十億參數的開放權重模型量化為四位元，以及兩個溫度。該研究確立了行為層面的差異存在，並且可以在分數中未被記錄，而不是任何比率可以普遍化。在 8B 模型下，溫度為 0.7 時，所有 43 個訂購組在五次相同的運行中發出不同的訂單集，26 個在某些運行中發出訂單而在其他運行中不發出，28 個記錄了不同的編碼值、劑量或分析物。在這 43 個中有 22 個，基準對實質上不同的行為報告相同的失敗判決，這與 4B 模型在 0.7 下的所有 10 個不同組相同。訂單在運行中也達到不同的終點，其中一個被記錄伺服器拒絕，而代理卻被告知它成功了。這些發現促使了重複運行評估、行為層面穩定性報告和執行忠實環境反饋在臨床代理基準中的應用。
